speaker: alse_pinder
text: I could not fill them, mistress. The Cheapside conduit was a press, and I came home with the buckets half full.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Set them down before you finish the spilling. You have the bread-board under your arm and the water at your feet. What press?

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Paul's churchyard, at noon. Apprentices, and masterless men. Then officers. Then everybody running.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You saw the running.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I saw the running. I did not stay to see what they ran at. A woman at the conduit said the armourers' shops. Another said Ludgate, and that they would break it open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the talk on the way home. It is not a thing you stood in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I stood until the buckets would not fill, and then I came away. I can say the shops again if you want them, but I did not see a shop.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Once is enough. Nobody in this house goes west of the Stocks again this month. The lodger included.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Paul's is west of the Stocks. I had meant to check a book there against a better copy. I am not going.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are not going, and Alse is not going, and the weaver is not going. I do not care which book it was.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Daniel. The third book. The copy I have will have to do.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I cannot read it, sir. I can tell you the churchyard was hot, and the men I saw had nothing in their hands.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing in their hands. If you tell it again, do not put a blade there that you did not see.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She will not tell it from room to room. Mark me. A story grows when it is walked through a house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I only went for the water. The rest came home in the buckets.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Half full is an honest measure. I will not help it to a fuller one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat, before you measure anything else. The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch, and it is still a penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat. I am not going west, and I am not sending anyone to look.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Norton Folgate is not west. The conduit is. I know the difference, because you have said so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have said it for the house. West of the Stocks is shut to us until I open it. This month.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This month. I have the board upstairs, and the book I already own.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I take the washing up, or is the stair shut with Cheapside?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The stair is not Cheapside. Eat first. Then take it up, and do not linger for a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no speech tonight. I did not see the square. I will not improve it from the stair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Then it stays what she saw, and what she heard, and the two are not the same.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: What I saw was the press, and the officers, and the running. What I heard was shops, and Ludgate. I can keep them apart.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep them apart. I will.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the penny loaf will be eaten before it is talked into a smaller one. Sit. I am still carrying this board, and I should like to put it down.
